shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated triangular or chevron-like marks
register or panel containing a row of repeated vertical abstract signs

justification: The most specific shared content is a horizontal decorative register with repeated triangular/chevron marks, plus a band-like organization of schematic linear signs. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by recognizable profile animals and creature figures distributed over the surface, while B mainly shows an abstract central panel of repeated sign-like forms with no comparable zoomorphic scene.
